title: The African Business 1984 Index provides a comprehensive overview of various economic and political developments across African nations throughout the year. Key highlights include discussions on the IMF's role in staving off economic disaster, changes in mining and taxation policies, and the impact of tourism and trade agreements. The index also covers significant events such as the death of PM Sokoine, the challenges faced by farmers, and the evolving telecommunications landscape. Overall, the document reflects the dynamic nature of African economies and the ongoing efforts to address challenges and seize opportunities.
